title: Active Recovery & Mobility - Vasaloppet Prep

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and deliberately, focusing on spinal articulation. Inhale on cow, exhale on cat. No rushing.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the switch between hip positions. Keep chest upright. Move gently through hip internal/external rotation.

items.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
items.cues: Gently pull toes toward shins, holding each rep briefly. Important for ski preparation and calf recovery.

items.name: Rowing Machine - Easy Pace
items.cues: Smooth, controlled strokes at RPE 4/5. Focus on leg drive first, then torso, then arms. Keep stroke rate around 18-20 SPM. This active recovery promotes blood flow without taxing the system.

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Use light resistance band. Pull band to chest with straight arms, focus on shoulder blade retraction. Excellent for postural recovery and upper back mobility.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Opposite arm and leg extensions. Move slowly with control. Engage core lightly. Enhances stability and body awareness for endurance sports.

items.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocates
items.cues: Use light band with arms straight. Bring band from front of body overhead and behind you. Promotes shoulder mobility crucial for skiing mechanics.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each leg 30 seconds. Lean forward gently with heel on ground. Important for Vasaloppet preparation to maintain calf flexibility.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Hold each arm 30 seconds against wall. Feel gentle stretch in biceps and shoulders. Counteracts pulling patterns from training.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Slow, controlled rocking motion through adductors. Breathe deeply. Crucial hip opener for distance skiing events.

items.name: Deep Breathing & Meditation
items.cues: Sit comfortably. Inhale for 4 counts, exhale for 6 counts. Reset nervous system and aid recovery after recent endurance work.

rationale: Recovery-focused workout (RPE 4-5) designed to complement the previous day's moderate-intensity endurance session (55min, RPE 6), promoting active recovery and blood flow without additional training stress
Strategic 53 days out from Vasaloppet 90km: emphasis on mobility, shoulder stability, and hip mobility work that directly supports ski-specific movement patterns and injury prevention

Light rowing machine work maintains aerobic conditioning while allowing CNS and muscular systems to recover; mobility and stretching address common ski endurance demands (hip flexors, calves, shoulders)
